descriptors.1: Author named but no current role or contact information
descriptors.2: Owner identified with role and contact information
descriptors.3: Owner identified with role, contact, and explicit review responsibility

descriptors.0: No indication of when the document was last reviewed
descriptors.1: Date of original creation present but no subsequent review record
descriptors.2: Last review date present and within organisational policy period
descriptors.3: Last review date present, within policy period, and accompanied by reviewer identification

descriptors.0: No indication of when the document should next be reviewed
descriptors.1: Review frequency stated in policy but not in the document itself
descriptors.2: Next review date or schedule explicitly stated in the document
descriptors.3: Next review date stated, with trigger conditions for ad-hoc review (e.g. system changes) also identified

descriptors.1: Version identifier present but no history or date of change
descriptors.2: Version identifier, date of last change, and author of last change present
descriptors.3: Full changelog with version, date, author, and summary of changes for each revision

descriptors.0: No classification indication present on the document
descriptors.1: Classification stated informally but not using the organisation's scheme
descriptors.2: Document carries an appropriate classification label per organisational scheme
descriptors.3: Classification label present, plus handling restrictions and any data-type-specific notes

descriptors.0: Document does not state its purpose or intended audience
descriptors.1: Purpose implied through content but not declared; audience not identified
descriptors.2: Purpose explicitly stated near the start of the document; audience identified
descriptors.3: Purpose, audience, and scope boundaries explicitly stated in a summary section

descriptors.0: No discernible structural organisation; content presented as undifferentiated prose
descriptors.1: Some headings or breaks present but structure does not match content type
descriptors.2: Structure appropriate to content type (numbered steps for procedures, sections for reference, etc.)
descriptors.3: Structure appropriate to content type, with summary, navigation aids (table of contents, headings), and visual aids (diagrams) where they support comprehension

descriptors.0: Document does not address what its purpose claims to cover
descriptors.1: Document addresses purpose partially; significant elements missing or referenced without explanation
descriptors.2: Document addresses all elements its purpose implies; for procedures, this includes the content elements specified in ISO 27002 §5.37 (responsibilities, steps, error handling, support contacts, recovery procedures)
descriptors.3: All purpose-relevant content present, plus explicit notes on what is out of scope

descriptors.0: Document assumes substantial prior knowledge or context that is not provided or referenced
descriptors.1: Document partially clarifies prerequisites but leaves significant unstated assumptions
descriptors.2: Document either provides necessary prerequisite context or references where it can be found; terminology is consistent
descriptors.3: Document is self-contained for its intended audience, including a glossary or terminology section where domain-specific terms appear; references to external sources are explicit

descriptors.0: Same concept referred to by different terms or vice versa; contradictions between sections; terminology inconsistent with related documents
descriptors.1: Mostly consistent internally but with several visible mismatches or contradictions
descriptors.2: Internally consistent in terminology and presentation; aligned with the conventions of related documents
descriptors.3: Internally consistent, aligned with related documents, and any deliberate deviations from organisational convention are explicitly justified

descriptors.0: No cross-references to related documents, systems, or sources; no way to verify factual claims
descriptors.1: Some cross-references present but broken, outdated, or insufficient
descriptors.2: Working cross-references to related documents, systems, and where applicable, sources for factual claims
descriptors.3: Cross-references are working, current, contextualised (the reader knows why the link matters), and the document explicitly identifies how its content can be verified

descriptors.0: Document does not identify any ISO controls or organisational policies it supports or implements. (N/A if the document is not subject to ISO/IEC 27001 controls, e.g. a glossary or contact list.)
descriptors.1: Document references ISO controls or policies generically without specifying which apply
descriptors.2: Document explicitly names the ISO controls and organisational policies it implements or supports
descriptors.3: All applicable controls and policies named, with explicit cross-references to the controlling documents or sections of the standard

descriptors.0: Document covers a system or process but does not address access control. (N/A if the document does not describe a system or process involving access decisions.)
descriptors.1: Access control mentioned but requirements not described
descriptors.2: Access control requirements described: who may access, the basis of access, and the access management process
descriptors.3: All §5.18 elements present plus revocation procedures, periodic review schedule, and reference to organisational access control policy

descriptors.0: Document is an operational procedure but addresses none of the elements specified in §5.37. (N/A if the document is not an operational procedure.)
descriptors.1: Some §5.37 elements present (responsibilities OR error handling OR support contacts) but most absent
descriptors.2: All §5.37 elements present: responsible individuals, configuration steps, information handling, backup, scheduling, error handling, support contacts, recovery procedures
descriptors.3: All §5.37 elements present plus explicit interdependencies with other procedures and tested validity (e.g. exercise records)
